title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Poppy House in Gulf Place – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Poppy House in Gulf Place. Welcome to Poppy House, the ultimate luxury retreat along 30A! This incredible 10 bedroom home sleeps 24 guests, making it perfect large families or group getaways.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Poppy House,'  the ultimate luxury retreat along 30A! This incredible 10 bedroom home sleeps 24 guests, making it perfect large families or group getaways. Step outside to an entertainers dream- a private pool, spa and fire pit awaits on the spacious patio. Enjoy breathtaking Gulf views and easy access to nearby Gulf Place, where dining, shopping, and entertainment are just steps away. With a golf cart and 10 adult bikes included, exploring 30A is a breeze! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps From the Beach -Gulf Views -Private Pool with Sitting Spa **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Gas Fire Pit -Grill- Propane -4 Passenger Moke  -10 Adult bikes -Elevator -Full Size Laundry on Each Floor -Beach Gear ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 24   FIRST FLOOR: - Bedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #2: Bunk Room- 2 Twin over Twin (sleeps 4) Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: - Bedroom #5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaker Tub - Bedroom #6: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaker Tub THIRD FLOOR: - Bedroom #7: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #8: Bunk Room- 2 Twin over Twin (sleeps 4),  Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #9: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bedroom #10: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING: Six driveway parking spaces available. Included is a 4 seater moke and 10 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. BEACH ACCESS Three public beach accesses a short distance from the home: 1. Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is located at the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, just across the street from Gulf Place rentals, shopping, and dining. This access is ADA accessible, and has two picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs and lifeguards during peak season. Ed Walline Regional Access is unique among SoWal accesses with a two-story viewing platform overlooking the beach and gulf - a great place to spot surfers and dolphins. 2. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal. 3. Spooky Lane Beach Access is at the entrance to Seahaunts Condominiums where Spooky Lane meets the Gulf. From the intersection of Scenic 393 at Gulf Place and Scenic 30A, travel east about 1/4 mile then south on Spooky Lane. There is parking for bikes only. GULF PLACE COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Casual. Colorful. Creative. Gulf Place is a beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. For sunset strolls and inspiring views, drift down to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. With ample parking, restrooms, bike racks and proximity to lifeguards in season, it couldn’t be more welcoming. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a 40 minute drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *Private Heated Pool With Spa **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Pool & spa are heated together. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
